subject.title: fix(agents): repair double-escaped JSON strings in tool call argument…

question: Is the new all-provider heuristic acceptable as the shared runtime fix for literal-escape corruption, or should it be constrained to a narrower validated boundary?
rationale: The repair deliberately changes parsed tool arguments across providers; source-level tests and one gateway proof support it, but accepting that compatibility tradeoff requires ownership judgment.

options.title: Accept the shared repair
options.body: Merge after the current head passes required checks and the embedded-agent owner accepts the guarded all-provider behavior.

options.title: Narrow the repair scope
options.body: Limit activation to a better-established malformed-stream signal or provider boundary if owner review finds the heuristic too broad.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the current head passes required checks and the embedded-agent owner accepts the guarded all-provider behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the current embedded-agent runtime ownership boundary rather than the external proposer alone.
